content.text: {"openings":[{"text":"Mayor Bramble tied the red sash to the book cart with a grand double-knot. “Tonight, the biggest parade wins my golden megaphone!” he boomed. Mina hugged the waiting books. Tuck polished a wheel until it winked. The cart gave a tiny creak, as if it had opinions.","when":[]},{"text":"The library smelled of paper, dust, and one cinnamon biscuit. Bramble fastened the sash to the cart and promised a golden megaphone to the grandest parade. Mina eyed the books still waiting for readers, while Tuck admired the cart’s splendid wheels. “Make it roll beautifully,” he whispered to them.","when":[{"key":"bramble.motive","op":"eq","value":"biggest","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Bramble tied on the sash. “A useful parade can be grand too,” he announced, though his voice still boomed like a brass bathtub. Mina brightened. Tuck patted a wheel and wondered whether the cart should visit readers or pose beneath the mayor’s judging eyes.","when":[{"key":"bramble.motive","op":"eq","value":"useful","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Mina knew readers were waiting at home, though Bramble pointed toward the square. Tuck heard the word “judge” and imagined every wheel receiving a shiny medal. The red sash fluttered between them, eager to lead somewhere.","when":[{"key":"mina.knows.audience_location","op":"eq","value":"homes","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Mina expected townspeople at the square, Tuck expected Mayor Bramble to judge the cart, and the red sash fluttered between them like a tiny flag with a secret. Nearby, a stack of books leaned toward the door.","when":[{"key":"mina.knows.audience_location","op":"eq","value":"square","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Somewhere beyond the library, readers were waiting, but Mina did not yet know where. Bramble wanted noise, Tuck wanted his cart admired, and the books sat quietly as if they knew the answer already.","when":[{"key":"mina.knows.audience_location","op":"eq","value":null,"at":"initial"}]}],"scenes":[{"scene":"tie_sash","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Bramble tied the sash tight, and the cart suddenly looked ready to lead a parade—or a very fancy queue.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"hear_boast","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina leaned close as Bramble explained his plan. “The largest-looking parade!” he said. “Noise enough to rattle the library dust.” Mina glanced at the waiting books and wondered whether dust was the audience he wanted.","when":[{"key":"mina.knows.bramble.motive","op":"eq","value":"biggest","at":"after"}]},{"text":"“A useful parade would be splendid too,” Bramble declared. Mina brightened. Tuck patted one wheel, as if it had just been invited to dinner. “Then let’s make the cart useful and splendid,” he said, although he seemed unsure which came first.","when":[{"key":"mina.knows.bramble.motive","op":"eq","value":"useful","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tuck_hears_boast","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Tuck listened with both hands on the handle. He pictured Mayor Bramble inspecting every wheel with a solemn, impressive squint. “Stand tall,” he murmured to the cart. “Your judge has eyebrows.”","when":[]}]},{"scene":"inspect_waiting_books","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina opened the bundle and discovered moon tales, puzzle books, and dragon dictionaries still waiting for their readers. “They have places to go,” she whispered. “They just need wheels.” One dragon dictionary flopped open to the word enormous.","when":[{"key":"mina.knows.books.waiting","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_tuck_about_readers","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"“These books are promised to readers beyond the steps,” Mina told Tuck. Tuck looked at the cart, then at his splendidly polished wheels. “Beyond the steps can still be a very fine direction,” he said.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"prepare_for_mayor","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tuck buffed the handle until it shone. “When Mayor Bramble judges us, this cart will stand taller than a giraffe in a hat!” he cried. Mina pictured the waiting readers, while the cart gleamed at its imagined judge.","when":[{"key":"cart.display_ready","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"switch_to_matched","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina lifted the tallest stack, then set it down. “Not a tower,” she decided. “A book for each waiting reader.” The cart seemed to breathe easier, and one loose bookmark waved like a little yes.","when":[{"key":"cart.load_style","op":"eq","value":"matched","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"load_matched_books","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina loaded reader-sized bundles: a dragon dictionary for one child, a puzzle book for another, and a moon tale on top. “Ready,” she said. “Not for showing off. For arriving.” Tuck gave the handle an admiring pat.","when":[{"key":"cart.loaded","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"stack_high","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tuck piled the books into a wobbling tower. “Behold!” he cried. The top book leaned left, the middle book leaned right, and the cart looked wonderfully enormous. Mina reached for the handle before the tower could sneeze.","when":[{"key":"cart.loaded","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"attach_bell","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Tuck clipped on the brass bell. It gave a bright jingle, volunteering for the most important job in town. Even the dust seemed to turn its head.","when":[{"key":"cart.bell","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"ring_square","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tuck rang the bell—CLANG!—and rolled the tall cart to the steps. The sash streamed behind it while the book tower wobbled like a well-read pudding. Bramble threw both arms up. At last, his parade looked enormous.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"spectacle","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"turn_to_homes","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina seized the handle. “The readers are waiting this way.” Tuck pushed beside her, and the cart turned toward the homes, carrying books chosen for actual hands. Behind them, the sash fluttered bravely away from the square.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"delivery","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"deliver_first_book","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"At the first doorway, Mina handed over a book. The cart grew lighter, and a delighted gasp popped out like a cork. Tuck whispered, “That is excellent parade noise.” From inside came the first turning page.","when":[{"key":"books.delivered","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"mayor_follows","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Bramble hurried after the cart, expecting cheers to catch up. The wheels made only a friendly rumble, but he kept marching, his mayoral hat bobbing like a determined mushroom.","when":[]}]},{"scene":"mayor_checks_steps","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Bramble marched to the steps and discovered only a small crowd. One pigeon looked interested. “Is that the audience?” he asked. The pigeon turned around, leaving Bramble with his enormous announcement and a very small silence.","when":[{"key":"bramble.location","op":"eq","value":"steps","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"discover_small_crowd","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Bramble discovered that the square was quiet. Down the lane, warm windows waited like open book covers. He listened to the hush, then to a distant child asking, “Is my book coming?”","when":[{"key":"bramble.knows.steps.crowd","op":"eq","value":"small","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"mayor_returns_to_library","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Bramble returned to the library, folding his enormous announcement into a much smaller voice. His hat no longer pointed at the sky; it pointed thoughtfully at the floor.","when":[{"key":"bramble.location","op":"eq","value":"library","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_mayor_about_readers","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mina told Bramble about the readers waiting at home and the books chosen for them. His golden megaphone suddenly seemed very large. “Could it announce a doorway?” he asked. Mina smiled. “It can try.”","when":[{"key":"bramble.knows.books.waiting","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"agree_small_can_be_grand","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Bramble removed his mayoral hat. “Perhaps grand means arriving where someone is waiting,” he said. Tuck measured the megaphone with his elbow. “It is also grandly handle-shaped,” he observed.","when":[{"key":"bramble.agreement","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"give_prize_to_tuck","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Bramble handed Tuck the golden megaphone. Tuck held it like a handle, grinning brighter than the brass. “My cart has won a prize,” he said, “and the prize has won a job.”","when":[{"key":"prize.owner","op":"eq","value":"tuck","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"give_prize_to_mina","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Bramble placed the golden megaphone in Mina’s hands. She set it beside the books, where it looked like a shiny bookmark. “For the library,” she said, and Bramble gave a smaller, warmer bow.","when":[{"key":"prize.owner","op":"eq","value":"mina","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"quiet_parade","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"On the steps, Mina chose a book for each listener. Tuck lowered the tower, and Bramble rang the bell once—softly. Children waved as the books opened like bright little doors, and the cart’s red sash settled across the handle.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"welcome","at":"after"}]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"The cart stood at the steps, piled high beneath its streaming sash. Bramble shouted into the golden megaphone, so large that only his eyebrows could be seen. The bell clanged, the tower wobbled, and the square suddenly had a parade big enough to echo.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"spectacle","at":"after"},{"key":"books.delivered","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"The tower wobbled, the bell clanged, and Mayor Bramble’s enormous prize swallowed his face while the books remained bundled for another day. Tuck bowed to the crowd. A bookmark peeped from the stack like a sleepy flag.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"spectacle","at":"after"},{"key":"books.delivered","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"The cart rolled toward the waiting homes. Even before the first book left, the lane seemed to lean closer, listening. Mina’s hands rested on the handle, and Tuck’s bright wheels carried the promise onward.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"delivery","at":"after"},{"key":"books.delivered","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Books left the cart one by one, and open pages glowed in separate doorways along the lane. Mina carried the prize while Tuck steadied the sash. The parade stretched from doorstep to doorstep, stitched together by stories.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"delivery","at":"after"},{"key":"books.delivered","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"prize.owner","op":"eq","value":"mina","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Books left the cart one by one, and open pages glowed in separate doorways along the lane. Tuck held the golden megaphone like a splendid handle, while Mina laughed at the cart’s proud little squeak.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"delivery","at":"after"},{"key":"books.delivered","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"prize.owner","op":"eq","value":"tuck","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The parade became small enough for the library steps and large enough for every waiting reader. Bramble’s agreement rested in the quiet smile beneath his hat. One soft bell chime floated out as children waved.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"welcome","at":"after"},{"key":"bramble.agreement","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Tuck lowered the tower, Mina lined up the books, and Bramble smiled at the little procession. The brass bell gave one gentle chime. On the steps, the golden megaphone gleamed beside the books, suddenly content to be quiet.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"welcome","at":"after"},{"key":"prize.owner","op":"eq","value":"mina","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The books made a small bright row, each one waiting beside its listener. Bramble’s boast had folded into a welcome, and the bell gave one soft chime while the children waved from the steps.","when":[{"key":"parade.kind","op":"eq","value":"welcome","at":"after"},{"key":"prize.owner","op":"eq","value":"tuck","at":"after"}]}],"lexicon":[]}
